poor.quote: those creatures forever crowd and shove, shout, bustle and litter
It is full to the brim.
And when all this had happened, so simply and imperceptibly
I was irritated by the uncertainty trembling inside me
our division was stationed back then

good.quote: I am sick of being an inn
Sweep out, along with the litter, the ones who make it.
They wove their existence together with mine into a fantastic net
roaring torrents of human life that came rushing at me like wild horses
the iron hand clack its bones in vain
like chips and straw on the spring floods
How I used to wait for them, at times!
